name: data-table
description: Config-driven record table backed by an Apex controller.
notes: Users need read access to the object and fields shown (grant via a permission set).
Add the component to a Lightning page and set objectApiName and columns.

name: modal
description: Accessible, SLDS-compliant modal dialog component with responsive sizing, slots, and keyboard navigation.

labels.shortDescription: Tooltip and aria-label for modal close button

notes: Use <c-modal is-open={isOpen} title='My Modal' onclose={handleClose}> to display dialogs.

contents.lwc/modal/modal.js-meta.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LightningComponentBundle xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <apiVersion>62.0</apiVersion>
    <isExposed>true</isExposed>
    <masterLabel>Modal Dialog</masterLabel>
    <description>Accessible, SLDS-compliant modal dialog component with responsive sizing, slots, and keyboard navigation.</description>
    <targets>
        <target>lightning__AppPage</target>
        <target>lightning__RecordPage</target>
        <target>lightning__HomePage</target>
    </targets>
</LightningComponentBundle>
